name: glowing-shadow
description: Marketing block with a rotating, color-cycling token glow behind display type. Hover brightens blur, opacity, and scale.
purpose: Puts a kinetic light field behind a wordmark or short claim so a landing moment feels lit without leaving semantic tokens.
bestFor: feature moments that need a glow without extra chrome
avoidFor: forms or task UI where a spinning field would compete with controls
